claim_boundary: Public ARC-GEN architecture comparison and held-out evidence only; no sealed external result, unrestricted invention, or world-level breakthrough.

controlled_comparison.required_improvement: complete depth 5 with at most 200000 total retained expressions and no more raw candidates than v26, or find an exact program

discovery_rule: retain every abstract exact structure independently solving at least two distinct discovery identities
language_semantics: exact v25 typed runtime and operators; v27 changes only deterministic frontier retention

search.exact_grid_retention: all exact target matches are retained even outside every beam
search.grid_beam_score: shape mismatch examples, then total cell Hamming distance to targets, then node count, then canonical AST
search.semantic_deduplication: retain lowest node count then canonical serialization for each semantic signature
search.support_beam_score: sum over demonstrations of minimum symmetric difference to a target-derived anchor; then node count; then canonical AST

validation_rule: freeze discovery library before importing validation generators; infer colour parameters only; exactly one abstract structure must be exact
verifier_requirement: independent evaluator and mutation-based verifier co-synthesis for every held-out success
